source_snapshot.procedure: SSH to BMC and execute `ncsi-cmd -m 12 --package 0 --channel 0 raw 0x00`.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command sends successfully and produces a response.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; preserves the literal command but labels the opaque raw operation read-only and accepts any response.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; requires vendor opcode semantics, endpoint mapping, decoder and recovery because read-only behavior is unproven.

old_problem: The core meaning and state effect of mode 12/raw opcode 0x00 are undocumented, package 0/channel 0 is not mapped to hardware, any response lacks an authoritative completion/payload oracle, and the command could disrupt the BMC management channel.
disposition_reason: ED-03 allows a draft around standard BMC behavior but forbids guessing OEM/raw parameters. Parameterizing package/channel identifiers cannot repair unknown command semantics, PASS/FAIL decoding or recovery. Until the exact ncsi-cmd build's mode/opcode specification and physical mapping are approved, issuing the command or calling it read-only would be unsafe and unverifiable.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2226, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2227 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00010-V001 / 18351bc0a91869e5 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Preserve the literal `-m 12 --package 0 --channel 0 raw 0x00` coverage but do not execute it until vendor semantics are established.
Required authority must define request bytes, state effect, success/error completion codes, payload layout and allowed post-state for the exact tool build.
Map logical package/channel to controller, NIC, port, MAC/interface and determine whether it carries the active BMC management path.
Before any later authorized execution, capture route/link/interface/channel baselines through an independent recovery path and send exactly once.
Nonempty stdout is not PASS; raw bytes, exit status, decoded completion/payload and unchanged/approved network post-state are required.
Stop on unknown completion, link/route/MAC change or BMC reachability loss; no automatic retry/reset.
No SSH login, raw NCSI command, network mutation, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Vendor-defined NCSI raw command response on mapped package/channel
test_case.purpose: Validate the BMC NCSI command path to the specifically mapped package 0/channel 0 using the exact approved mode 12/raw 0x00 semantics and authoritative response decoder without disrupting management connectivity.
required_package: Exact BMC firmware and ncsi-cmd build/provider
Vendor specification for mode 12/raw 0x00 request, state effect, completion and payload
Expected decoded response, allowable post-state and independent recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not execute until the vendor semantics and endpoint map are approved. Then, through a trusted independent management path, capture NCSI/network baseline, send the literal command exactly once, preserve stdout/stderr/exit/raw bytes, decode completion/payload with the approved specification, and verify the authorized post-state.
test_case.expected_result: The exact mapped endpoint returns the documented successful completion and payload, and link/route/interface/channel/BMC health remains unchanged or matches the explicitly approved state transition with recovery completed.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative vendor semantics, correct physical mapping, decoded success/payload and approved post-state. Any-response/nonempty-output is insufficient. Missing semantics/map/decoder/recovery keeps the case Pending; unknown completion or unexpected network state is FAIL if execution was authorized.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact vendor command semantics, physical mapping, management blast radius and recovery are approved.
Trusted authentication and an independent recovery path are mandatory.
One invocation only; no package/channel guessing, automatic retry, reset or configuration change.
Stop on any reachability, link, route, MAC or decoder anomaly.
expected_evidence: Physical package/channel/NIC/port/interface mapping and management role
Single invocation stdout/stderr/exit/raw bytes, decoded completion/payload and recovery
test_case.recovery: Recovery cannot be safely finalized until the vendor state effect is known. The owner must supply an independent path and exact restore procedure; on anomaly, preserve evidence and do not retry or reset automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The unique source specifies one literal command; its semantics are missing rather than contradicted.

blocked.reason: The test purpose is identifiable, but execution remains engineering-decision pending because vendor semantics and safe recovery are irreducible prerequisites; it is not converted to global BLOCKED.
